Maya R.: Quick heads-up — noticed the SDK surfaces a generic `Error` for token refresh failures and it ends up mapping to HTTP 500 in our sample apps. That makes it hard for product code to decide retry vs user flow. Anyone else hitting this?

Samir K.: Yup, saw this too in the onboarding sample. Currently the SDK just wraps into `ApiError(message)` — no stable types or retry hints.

Evan L.: +1. Also the error `message` is long stack trace sometimes and we have no `retry_hint` or machine-readable code. Docs mention mapping (401->Auth, 429->RateLimit, 5xx->Server) but SDK behavior doesn't match.

Priya N.: Hit this when building the quickstart: our client treated 500 as non-retryable and surfaced confusing copy to users. Suggest adding explicit typed exceptions and a `retry_hint` field in the error object returned by the SDK.

Maya R.: Proposal: SDK should expose typed exceptions: `AuthError`, `RateLimitError` (with `retry_after`), `ClientError`, `ServerError`, `TransientNetworkError`. Also include `http_status` and a short `human_message` plus `dev_message`/`details`. Keep human_message snackable for UI.

Samir K.: Implementation idea: have a common base `RedwoodError` with properties `code` (enum), `http_status`, `retry_hint`, `details`. In JS throw subclass instances; in Python raise subclass. Update sample apps to show pattern.

Evan L.: Edge cases: some 4xx are not retryable (409 conflict) and 429 sometimes includes `Retry-After`. We should document a mapping table in the docs and make SDK follow it strictly.

Priya N.: UX note: for frontends we want one-liners like `human_message: "Session expired — please sign in again."` and verbose `dev_message` for logs e.g. `dev_message: "refresh token expired, refresh request returned 401: invalid_grant"`.

devops-bot: deploy status: build queued for `sdk/pylib#456` — CI reported unit tests pending.

Maya R.: Action items: 1) spec mapping table in docs (Priya) 2) JS + Py SDK typed error surface (Samir/Evan) 3) update sample apps + onboarding snippets (Maya) 4) add unit/e2e tests to simulate 401/429/500 retry behavior. Target: next sprint. Who picks up the mapping spec?

Priya N.: I'll draft the mapping doc with examples and sample responses, will push a PR to docs by EOD Friday.

Samir K.: I'll start the JS SDK PR to introduce typed exceptions, add tests and update TS types.

Evan L.: I'll take Python SDK and the sample app changes; I'll add an integration test that mocks 401/429/503 and asserts exception classes and retry hints.

Maya R.: Perfect — I'll add a card to the sprint board and label this `dx-error-ergonomics`. Also let's include telemetry change: record `error.type` and `http_status`. :thumbsup:

Samir K.: small follow-up: telemetry currently logs only `message` — please include machine fields (type/status) so we can alert on error-class regressions.

Priya N.: noted, will include telemetry fields in the spec.

Maya R.: Thanks all — keeping the thread here so we don't lose the action items.
